reviews.text: Having been my bully's vet for 10 years, I couldn't have hoped for a better one. A perfect blend of professionalism, humanity, and love for animals.

Not just a simple doctor... a family member... a guide for our furry family... an example of professionalism, honesty, humility and empathy... in her office you feel at home... highly recommended... she does this job as a mission more than a profession ❤️❤️

A doctor like few others! Dr. Cerqua is a professional who carries out her work with true passion and dedication. She's never self-interested and always makes sure to meet our needs. We have many pets in the family—our own, my mother's, and my mother-in-law's—and she's always available, ready to lend us a hand. She's super professional and always there, even in the most difficult times. I've had to contact her several times, even on holidays, and despite it all, she's always ready to answer and offer us support. We trust her implicitly, and it's a feeling of security knowing our pets are in her care. We couldn't ask for anything better!
I have known Dr. Cerqua for about 20 years, I wouldn't change her for anyone in the world, professional, kind, always available, no one gives me security like her. What can I say, the best
My Maltese brother Paco had his hernia operated on, and I must say that everything went 100% professionally.
